Directions: Based on the passage below and on your knowledge of social studies, answer each question that follows.
Content: ... The world must be made safe for democracy. Its peace must be planted upon the tested foundations of political liberty. We have no selfish ends to serve. We desire no conquest, no dominion. We seek no indemnities [repayments] for ourselves, no material compensation for the sacrifices we shall freely make. We are but `text(one)` of the champions of the rights of mankind. We shall be satisfied when those rights have been made as secure as the faith and the freedom of nations can make them...
